title: Where the extension runs
description: A .vsix installed in VS Code: the extension runs in the extension host and the page in a webview, which reads the workspace's files through VS Code and loads its libraries from jsDelivr.

nodes.name: VS Code
nodes.description: VS Code 1.85 or later, desktop or web, with the extension installed from a .vsix.

nodes.name: Webview
nodes.description: Runs the page, under the policy page.js writes.

nodes.name: Workspace files
nodes.description: The folder's .dev/*.json files, or those under .cyberspace-explorer/, on disk or in a remote workspace.

nodes.name: jsDelivr
nodes.description: Serves dagre, three.js and the Barlow typefaces.

artifacts.name: cyberspace-explorer-<version>.vsix
artifacts.description: The extension with media/index.html and LICENSE copied in by vscode:prepublish, built by npm run package.
